subject: Re: 🔵{Brand} & MobUpps
body:
Hi RECIPIENT_NAME,
Following up on my note about driving completed applications for {Brand} on a cost-per-sale basis. The one point worth repeating: you pay per finished, submitted application rather than per click or per job view, read through your web pixel and a server-to-server postback that passes click ID and a unique application ID off your own stack. The application bills only once a candidate completes the apply flow, deduped and bot-screened first. At scale we hold 7,500 completed applications a day (illustrative). Worth a short look at the validation screen?
angle: warm bump, restate completed-application proof (CPS billing + S2S postback + dedupe/bot screen)
illustrative_flags: 7,500 completed applications a day (MobUpps daily completed-application volume; illustrative, not audited or guaranteed)
register_notes: Stage 1 EN jobs_recruitment CPS: references prior outreach in first sentence; restates ONE proof point from parent (pay per completed application, web pixel + S2S postback passing click ID and unique application ID, dedupe/bot screen before billing); one illustrative MobUpps figure (7,500 completed applications/day, flagged inline and in illustrative_flags); soft CTA, exactly one question mark; {Brand} and RECIPIENT_NAME tokens kept; no sign-off, no em-dash, no curly quotes, no 'X, not Y' (stated positively as 'rather than per click'); native business English.
